$comment: Which matches get a won-match reel (W01..: every own kill of the match plus the result screen, V canvas; pieces in data/clip/montage.json). User decision D315 (2026-11-09), replacing the VICTORY-only selection of D237. A match gets a reel when any rule passes. Every condition of a rule must hold. A condition whose signal was not read leaves the rule inert: an inert rule never gives a reel (no guessing). Signals come from services/clip/match_gate.py segment(): result = W1 (a signalled VICTORY/DEFEAT box), place = the own card on the S1 top-3 screen, mode = the match mode from on-screen evidence (match_gate.game_mode: the S1 top-3 mode name, C1 mode cues and W1 round subtitles; none when they disagree), kills = own kills (scoreboard if read, else the deduplicated own kill-feed lines), roundKills = own kill-feed kills between W1 round-end banners (pack 0.6.0). Thresholds are the user's words; detector status is in detectors.json.
user: for won if top3 go ahead. if defeat if it's top go ahead. if won or defeat if the kills are more than 20 (in hardpoint, domination, control) - go ahead, if it's TDM kills above 7 go ahead, in search if it a win or muliple kills within a round go ahead.

rules.label: defeated and placed top 2
rules.note: User D315a (2026-11-09): 'if it's top' means top 2 (defeat max place 2). No DEFEAT top-3 screen has been seen yet, so which team's top 3 it shows is unverified (detector, not rule).

rules.label: more than 20 own kills in Hardpoint, Domination or Control
rules.note: User D315, won or defeated. Read on top-3 screens: 'hardpoint' (2026-11-08), 'domination' and 'control' (2026-11-09; CONTROL in the S1 modeNames from pack 0.6.0).

rules.label: more than 7 own kills in Team Deathmatch
rules.note: User D315: 'if it's TDM kills above 7'. Won or defeated. A ranked TDM top-3 screen (RATING cards) was read on 2026-11-09 from pack 0.6.0.

rules.label: won a Search and Destroy match
rules.note: User D315: 'in search if it a win'. Search and Destroy top-3 screens read on 2026-11-09 ('SEARCH & DESTROY', modeNames alias from pack 0.6.0).

rules.label: at least 2 own kills within one Search and Destroy round
rules.note: User D315: 'muliple kills within a round' (multiple = at least 2). Round boundaries come from W1 round-end banners (pack 0.6.0, status unverified; docs/evidence/2026-11-10-round-vs-match-end.md). pieces (D326, user feedback F1 2026-11-10): a match that qualifies only by this rule shows the own kills of the rounds with at least 2 own kills, not the whole match.

impactPlay.label: the streamer's impact play: MVP animation, impact-play camera, up to the results page
impactPlay.user: if there was an impact play by the streamer, create it as a separate reel with MVP animation, Impact play cam and up to the results page
impactPlay.note: User feedback F4, 2026-11-10 (approved in the user's words). One separate reel per match whose IMPACT PLAY screen (M2, the profile name on the impact player's card) belongs to the streamer, cut from the V recording next to the match reel. 2026-11-09 practice (docs/evidence/2026-11-10-reel-own-kills-impact-play.md): the match-end banner, then the MVP animation (about 4 s), the impact-play camera (16-22 s), a loading screen, the top-3 screen and the results page (summary screen, C2) follow each other; the M2 card showed the own name in 2 of 5 impact plays. Times are agent values (proposed, unverified): startAfterBannerSec skips the banner, fallbackLeadSec is used when no banner was read, endHoldSec keeps the results page on screen, minSec and maxSec bound the reel; resultsAfterSec as C2 afterEndSec. Off until the flag is switched on.
